# Append-only evidence record (issue #136). Add new dated entries below; do not edit old ones.
# Reproduce: flow/fabulous.sh   (FABulous 2.2.0, Icarus Verilog 13.0)

2026-10-09  design/fabulous/tb_configmem_equiv.v  (adapter: flow/configmem_frames.py)
  SCOPE : frame STORAGE only (FrameData/FrameStrobe -> ConfigBits). NOT a verification
          of any hardware serial receiver / stream controller; none exists in this repo.
  DUT   : FABulous-generated Tile/LOGIC4/LOGIC4_ConfigMem.v + Fabric/models_pack.v
          (config_latch), unmodified, generated into gitignored flow/build/.
          sha256 LOGIC4_ConfigMem.v = dcdfc776e732e5ed0043014bd4a4aefab0981baec9ea0f0d9a767df42a2e2686
          sha256 models_pack.v      = 0bb111e18e1941b5c21d528ef60d2e3195ed311b99f59c35c9f2fc8543344a09
  REF   : sim/bitstream/logic4_configmem.map (158 entries, ConfigBits idx -> frame*32+bit)
          and the recorded sim/bitstream/{top_io,top_reg}.cfg + corpus/*.cfg vectors.
  Method: legal frame writes (data, one-hot strobe, strobe release, FrameData scrambled)
          with the full 158-bit ConfigBits (and ConfigBits_N == ~ConfigBits) compared after
          each write. Walking-one and walking-zero on all 20x32 frame bits, alternating
          patterns with single-frame inversion (retention), set/clear/overwrite sequences,
          writes to unused positions (frame 4 bits 30-31, frames 5..19), data changes with no
          strobe, 5000 random writes; then frame payloads of all 13 committed baseline
          streams replayed (adapter only unpacks words, does not use the map) and final
          ConfigBits compared with the recorded .cfg.
  Result: PASS: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 7274 checks, 13 baseline streams, 0 failures
  Scratch mutations of the generated ConfigMem (flow/fabulous.sh fails if either passes):
    select: frame2_bit5 latch enable FrameStrobe[2] -> FrameStrobe[3]
            -> FAIL: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 2525 failures / 7274 checks
    map   : ConfigBits[100] <-> ConfigBits[101] output swap
            -> FAIL: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 2680 failures / 7274 checks

2026-10-10  design/fabulous/tb_configmem_equiv.v  (issue #195: transparent-open phase)
  SCOPE : frame STORAGE only; same DUT, REF and sha256 values as the entry above (unchanged).
          No timing claim. Generated config_latch confirmed level-sensitive
          (always @(*) with if (E == 1'b1), no posedge/negedge) by flow/fabulous.sh before the run.
  Method: previous checks retained. New phase, per populated frame (5 frames): strobe rises
          with data present, then FrameData changes (ones, zeros, aaaa, 5555, ones, walking
          one and walking zero on all 32 bits, 8 random) with the one-hot strobe held high;
          ConfigBits and ConfigBits_N compared after each settled change (other frames must
          retain); strobe released, then FrameData changed 6 times with retention checked.
          Coverage requires every one of the 158 mapped bits to change value while its strobe
          stayed asserted.
  Result: PASS: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 7708 checks, 17 baseline streams, 0 failures; transparent-open: 5 frames, 158/158 mapped bits changed under asserted strobe, 385 settled changes, 430 checks, 0 failures
  Scratch mutations (flow/fabulous.sh fails if any passes, if a run does not complete, or if
  an edge-storage mutant is not caught by transparent-open failures):
    select: -> FAIL: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 3019 failures / 7708 checks (174 transparent-open failures / 430 checks)
    map   : -> FAIL: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 2877 failures / 7708 checks (98 transparent-open failures / 430 checks)
    rise  : config_latch -> always @(posedge E) storage (scratch models_pack.v copy)
            -> FAIL: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 458 failures / 7708 checks (428 transparent-open failures / 430 checks)
    fall  : config_latch -> always @(negedge E) storage (scratch models_pack.v copy)
            -> FAIL: configmem_fabulous_equiv -- 383 failures / 7708 checks (383 transparent-open failures / 430 checks)
